purpose: This table is a clean, deduplicated carrier reference for the sixteen airlines that flew from New York City in 2013, mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full legal name, intended to feed joins against flight-level fact tables keyed on carrier.
usage: Join downstream flight or segment tables to this table on the carrier column to resolve the full airline name; carrier is the declared grain and every value is non-null and unique per the profile, so no additional null-filtering is required by consumers.
limitations: The profile shows a small, fully populated sixteen-row lookup with zero nulls and zero duplicate rows, so no cleanup ambiguities remain; consumers should note this table reflects only carriers present in the 2013 NYC-origin flight data and is not a complete industry-wide carrier list.
